wish: someone should make an app that randomly adds ghostly figures to photos you take
spec:
Adds a faint ghostly figure at a random spot, size and opacity to a photo.
Choose a photo (a sample shows first), tap haunt again to reroll, tap save to download the PNG.
It does not upload anything, use the live camera, or edit the photo otherwise.
notes: Photo is read locally via createImageBitmap; save downloads a PNG.
